lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
For interconnections between people and places, write a located description, one data/map observation and one evidenced explanation.

FEEDBACK
Strong answer: place is clear; claim links to map/data; no invented cultural detail.

Independently complete a substantial task on interconnections between people and places: use at least two published sources or data sets, show analysis (not copy-out), note uncertainties, and write a five-sentence reflection with one skill goal. If First Nations content arises, use approved sources only and mark Community verification needs.

Write a short reflection naming one source or idea you corrected and why.
